rounds.observation: All 18 synthetic fields fully supported, no ray misses. Lobe median thickness exceeds waist in all nine neck cases. Native frog has 11 unsupported faces despite zero missed rays; sculpt is fully supported.
rounds.hypothesis: An inward-cone shape-diameter field supplies independent lobe-versus-neck information without geodesic-ball cut proposals.

rounds.hypothesis: Area-filtered persistent thickness maxima distinguish substantive lobes without geodesic-ball cut proposals or fixed part count.

rounds.rule: Descending superlevel components, simultaneous plateaus, elder-rule peak death; keep relative persistence >= .25 and above-saddle core area >= .02 of total, plus global root. Cancel other peaks through parent tree, canonicalize connected drainage regions, intersect native baseline labels.
rounds.stop_rule: Reject incomplete fields; no silent imputation, no parameter changes after the first Round 2 segmentation.

Frog yields seven substantive thickness regions plus four preserved baseline islands (11 total); two-view inspection still shows non-anatomical front/back patches and jagged boundaries. Sculpt regresses from five to 24 baseline-intersected regions. No adoption.
rounds.hypothesis: Applying the area threshold to exclusive connected regions removes residual pole/root fragments without losing the substantive thickness lobes.
rounds.prediction: All nine neck controls produce two connected regions, all nine decorative/convex controls remain one. Native comparisons remain exploratory and may still regress sculpt or miss tapering frog limbs.
rounds.rule: Explicit nearest-valid completion limited to .005 total area and .02 sqrt(area) graph distance. Unchanged persistence selector, then merge the smallest sub-.02 connected region into its longest shared boundary neighbor, including root fragments. Intersect baseline only after cleanup.
rounds.stop_rule: No hidden lowering of valid-ray threshold, no post-intersection removal of baseline boundaries. Any next scientific change consumes Round 4.

Counts should survive density, diagonal, ordering and rigid/scale changes. Native METHOD-039/040 base-fixture counts are descriptive, not presupposed.
rounds.rule: No method change. Sphere portion x in [-1,.9], radius sqrt(1-x*x), joined to taper r=sqrt(.19)*(1-t), x=.9+1.7*t. Bulged variant adds .45*sin(pi*t)*exp(-((t-.55)/.16)^2). Base32x24, dense64x48, diagonal flip, reversed vertex+face numbering, and scale3.7 with two rotations/translation. Measure actual field and labels, do not assume radius equals measured thickness.
rounds.stop_rule: Final round. Preserve failures and raw fields; no hard-edge guard, no smoothing changes, no fifth tuning pass.
